styleLock.direction: fresh leaf-green menswear editorial commerce built on rounded caption-bar cards and hairline-framed photo panels
styleLock.backgroundSystem: one flat page per screen assembled from set devices instead of scenery: rounded viewport cards closed by a solid leaf-green caption bar #58BE63 on a matte paper field #F5F7F4 for the cover and collar screens, a mint editorial panel #E3F1E4 carrying hairline-framed photo cards set on the diagonal for the craft screen, a letterless header tab over a deliberately blurred cool facade band for the scene band, and an asymmetric four-card mosaic on the paper field #F5F7F4 for the close; no two neighbouring screens share the same base field, no gradient, no scenic depth beyond that one blurred facade band
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool daylight studio light around 6000K, large front-left softbox key with a right fill card, one sweeping skim of light along rib valleys, seams and husk fibres to open the surface, soft contact shadows only under hems and dish rims, no flat wash-out and no hard shadow wall, low specular
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte paper field #F5F7F4 as the page ground, matte mint panel #E3F1E4 as the insert ground, one shallow mint dish for the still-life screen; hairline rules and card corners are the only surface decoration, no plaster wall, no bedding, no cement floor, no laminate board
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif as the single family, Chinese copy only as short placeholder lines inside reserved zones, one headline per screen, no serif, no script, no handwritten or retro lettering, no large English display lines and no dates or season codes
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight hairline line marks in leaf green #58BE63, plus one letterless seal ring and one blank rectangular action slot cut into the footer band; no filled badges, no 3D icons, no numbered circles, no QR code
styleLock.presentationRules: worn screens are always framed from the neck down or cropped at the crown so no face is readable; the chest-height garment scale repeats across the cover and mosaic screens; on-body scale and still-life scale never mix inside one card; caption bars never cross the collar line or the hem line; the ribbed collar stays the single recurring read across screens
noDrift: no color palette changes and no fifth hue outside the four locked tones
no mixed fonts and no serif, script or handwritten lettering
no random backgrounds and no scenic depth beyond the one blurred facade band
no visible model face, no watermark, no QR code and no store or membership badge
no invented fabric composition, gram weight, origin, grade, size or test figures
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh leaf-green menswear editorial visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte paper field #F5F7F4, mint editorial panel #E3F1E4, leaf-green caption bar #58BE63 and pine-ink text #222B20; cool daylight studio light around 6000K with a large front-left softbox key, a right fill card, one sweeping skim of light across rib and seam texture and soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif as the single type family with copy only inside clean reserved zones and one headline per screen; rounded viewport cards closed by a solid leaf-green caption bar, hairline-framed photo cards and a letterless header tab as the only recurring set devices; worn screens always framed from the neck down so no face is needed; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented fabric percentages, gram weights, origin or grade claims, size figures or test data.

provenance.notes: 7 张切片逐屏事实：①封面屏——素白页加草绿实心色块，顶部一行英文大写横标与一行日期，右侧竖排大字标题，主图为成年男模腰以上、城市旧楼虚化的青绿背景中穿一件纯白圆领套头短袖并伸手做手势；②场合屏——淡灰白场一张粗黑大标题加三张完全相同的圆角竖卡并排，每卡底部一枚绿色胶囊标签；③领口屏——白色场一张大圆角卡加两张小圆角卡，卡片底部压一条绿色标题带写领口卖点；④原料屏——极浅灰场正中一颗开壳棉铃带褐色壳尖，顶部绿色胶囊加粗黑大标题；⑤细节屏——薄荷绿场两张绿色细线描边照片卡对角错位排布，标题下有荧光色块衬底，右侧两栏正文；⑥模特屏——淡场居中大标题与一枚绿色胶囊，其下起一条满版横铺人像带；⑦收口屏——满版人像带下方非对称三卡拼贴加右上一张竖卡，左下角为二维码与会员促销黑标。品类判定依据：画面主体为套头穿脱、无前开襟、无拉链、无按扣、无帽兜与抽绳的圆领短袖针织上衣，按作业规则套头无开襟无拉链按扣判为上衣而非外套；切片中未见臀围／大腿围／脚口等下装量法，肩宽与胸围比例落在男码区间且为外穿，故判为 男装／上衣，与源夹名一致，无需改判。已剥离内容：素材站水印与站名字标、两处黑色会员促销角标与二维码引流贴片、全店免邮一类促销字样、原模特面部身份与手势、原版式全部中英文标语行与日期行（改为无日期无英文字标的主标题位）、原料产地与纤维成分表述（原料屏只保留视觉事实并在 negative 内显式禁写成分百分比与产地等级）、三张同姿态卡的重复摆拍（改为三格真实不同姿态）。与库内近似模版（男装／上衣的薄荷绿基础款圆领短袖、雾蓝球面修身圆领短袖、麻灰落肩抽绳连帽卫衣、酸柠檬半高领宽罗纹卫衣、砖红衬衫领假两件毛衣）逐条差异：1）色板与色温体系整体换成素纸白浅场／薄荷版面／叶绿标带／松墨字色的浅草绿撞色，男装段此前没有以绿色实心标条作为版式主装置的一套，且完全不复用同段已登记任何一块底色；2）背景体系由平涂棚墙、纸样台、床品与水泥地面改为圆角视口卡加底部绿色标条、薄荷场细线描边卡对角错位、淡场满版人像带、非对称四格拼贴四种版式装置，全套不出现衣架、金属球、跳绳、枕品与 laminate 台面；3）机位体系改用封面 slight 3/4、三格水平正面、领口 high 45 度俯视、原料 near-flat 75 度顶视、袖线 90 度侧身、背面 45 度后侧、收口多格正面共六种角度，取消低角度仰拍与顶视平铺尺码表，且三张同姿态卡在本套被改写成同机位不同姿态；4）道具仅一枚开壳棉铃置于浅薄荷圆盘并配一条细线引出空白标签，区别于近似款的干荚角、散纤维编织篮、吊牌胶囊、编号圆圈与色卡宫格；5）分镜角色序列为 HERO>SCENE>DETAIL>DETAIL>DETAIL>SCENE>CTA，不含痛点屏、双格对比屏与多色宫格屏，收口镜改为四格拼贴加空白行动位而非优惠促销收口；6）版式元件统一为主标题加底部标条加荧光衬块加空白行动位，删除原页英文大写标语行与日期行，图标只保留单权重细线与无字印章环。三种 temperature 取值在本段已被占满，故本套不靠冷暖区分，而以上述色板构成、标条装置、背景版式、机位序列、道具与元件体系与同段各套逐条区分。
